title: Entry point contract cannot interact with `OmoAgent.sol` functions
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Most of the functions in `OmoAgent.sol` contract will be triggered by the entry point contract e.g.`borrowAsset()`, `repayAsset()`, `topOffToAgent()` and more.
